包含流程、参数、输入绑定、Dry-run 与环境快照的 HTML、Markdow: HTML, Markdown, or JSON files containing the pipeline, parameters, input bindings, dry-run, and environment snapshot.
包含目标受试者功能像和结构像的 BIDS 根目录。: BIDS root directory containing the target subject's functional and structural images.
单个外部软件或命令步骤的计划超时时间。: Planned timeout for a single external software or command step.
单个多线程工具最多使用的线程数。: Maximum number of threads used by a single multithreaded tool.
单个多线程节点使用的线程数。: Number of threads used by a single multithreaded node.
单组织数据使用 CSD；多壳层多组织数据使用 MSMT-CSD。: Use CSD for single-tissue data; use MSMT-CSD for multi-shell multi-tissue data.
历史输出未能唯一覆盖所有样本；可明确选择仅使用匹配样本，至少需匹配一个样本: Historical outputs failed to uniquely cover all samples; one may explicitly choose to use only matching samples, requiring at least one matching sample
历史运行证据与当前契约或执行代码不匹配，需要重新验证。: The historical run evidence does not match the current contract or execution code and requires revalidation.
原 BNT 模型的位置嵌入特征维度。: Positional embedding feature dimension of the original BNT model.
原 CWT 片段使用未定义的 low_idx/high_idx，且不能把它替换成: The original CWT segment uses an undefined low_idx/high_idx, and it cannot be replaced with Welch band power to claim that the same algorithm is executable.
原 Skill 使用 torchaudio.transforms.MelSpec: The original Skill uses torchaudio.transforms.MelSpectrogram; the current Torch environment does not have torchaudio.
原 WMH 分割软件和对应模型权重未部署；不能用现有通用分割库代替。: The original WMH segmentation software and corresponding model weights are not deployed; existing general-purpose segmentation libraries cannot be used as substitutes.
原参考的 -t y 不是已安装 dcm2niix 的切片时序开关；转换器默认从有: The -t y in the original reference is not the slice timing switch of the installed dcm2niix; the converter writes the corresponding JSON field from valid DICOM by default, and this option cannot be used to ensure that missing timing is restored.
原始 EEG 文件. Required file input for 原脚本 F: Raw EEG file. Required file input for the original script F3/F4 filtered post-mean ratio (non-log power difference); bind to port input.
原始 EEG 文件. Required file input for 原脚本 W: Raw EEG file. Required file input for the original script Welch band power and band-splitting file; bind to port input.
原始 EEG 文件. Required file input for 原脚本 m: Raw EEG file. Required file input for the original script mne_microstates analysis; bind to port input.
原始 FC 数据根目录（内含 atlas/sub-*.pt）: Raw FC data root directory (containing atlas/sub-*.pt)
原始 FC 数据根目录（内含 atlas/sub-*.pt）. Required: Raw FC data root directory (containing atlas/sub-*.pt). Required directory input for the original BNT project training script; bind to port fmri_root.
Raw FC data root directory (containing atlas/sub-*.pt). Required directory input for the original BRAINNETCNN project training script; bind to port fmri_root.
Raw FC data root directory (containing atlas/sub-*.pt). Required directory input for the original COMBRAINTF project training script; bind to port fmri_root.
原始 Transformer 模型的隐藏特征维度。: Hidden feature dimension of the original Transformer model.
原始帮助作为文档提供。: Original help is provided as documentation.
原始注意力模型的注意力头数，需要满足模型隐藏维度的整除约束。: The number of attention heads in the original attention model must satisfy the divisibility constraint of the model hidden dimension.
原始训练脚本的训练轮数。: The number of training epochs of the original training script.
原文没有定义 DICOM 序列到 BIDS 实体的确定映射。dcm2niix 转: The original text does not define a deterministic mapping from DICOM series to BIDS entities. dcm2niix conversion and explicit file mapping organization can already be run separately; complete automatic organization still requires acquisition rules and a complete BIDS validator.
原文要求源空间 parcel 连接；当前连接入口处理传感器 Epochs，不能当: The original text requires source-space parcel connectivity; the current connectivity entry point processes sensor Epochs and cannot be regarded as a source-space result. An explicit contract for source estimation, parcellation, and connectivity method is needed.
原文调用的 neurooracle 软件包、ingest/batch_extra: The neurooracle software package called by the original text and the ingest/batch_extract/phase3 entry point are not provided with the current project; the existing scripts are usage references and auxiliary functions and cannot replace the complete atlas engine.
原流程要求 MATLAB/SPM/CONN 环境与对应项目设计；当前未配置。Ni: The original pipeline requires the MATLAB/SPM/CONN environment and the corresponding project design; it is not currently configured. The Nilearn operation of the same name cannot serve as the CONN algorithm.
原流程要求完整 bids-validator CLI；已安装的 Python b: The original pipeline requires the complete bids-validator CLI; the installed Python bids_validator only validates file names and cannot replace the entire BIDS dataset validator.
原脚本 BOLD 频带波动区域摘要（STD 指标）: Summary of BOLD frequency-band fluctuation regions from the original script (STD metric)
原脚本 CSP、频带、Hjorth 与熵特征: CSP, frequency-band, Hjorth, and entropy features from the original script
原脚本 ERP 峰值、潜伏期与 AUC: ERP peak, latency, and AUC from the original script
原脚本 F3/F4 滤波后均值比值（非对数功率差）: Mean ratio after F3/F4 filtering from the original script (not log power difference)
原脚本 Welch 频带功率与分频文件: Welch frequency-band power and band-split files from the original script
原脚本 mne_microstates 分析: mne_microstates analysis from the original script
原脚本依赖不存在的 mne.preprocessing.find_bad_cha: The original script depends on the nonexistent mne.preprocessing.find_bad_channels / AutoReject, and the AutoReject call on continuous Raw does not conform to that API; LOF or another cleaning algorithm must not be used to replace the original definition.
原脚本所需 4D BOLD: 4D BOLD required by the original script
原表中的 ASLPREPCORE、单独 M0 归一化、PVC 或 --qc 没有: ASLPREPCORE, standalone M0 normalization, PVC, or --qc in the original table do not have corresponding complete callable entry points; the existing compute_cbf only implements its declared CBF quantification and does not impersonate these independent operations.
原训练入口优化器的权重衰减系数。: The weight decay coefficient of the optimizer in the original training entry point.
原训练入口使用的图谱目录名称，必须与输入数据的实际目录结构一致。: The atlas directory name used by the original training entry point must be consistent with the actual directory structure of the input data.
原训练入口的任务类型：分类或回归；影响目标、拆分及损失函数。: The task type of the original training entry point: classification or regression; affects the objective, splitting, and loss function.
原训练损失中 DEC 聚类项的权重；总损失使用任务损失加该权重乘聚类损失。: The weight of the DEC clustering term in the original training loss; the total loss uses the task loss plus this weight multiplied by the clustering loss.
原训练脚本的交叉验证折数；实际拆分还受有效样本数和类别分布限制。: The number of cross-validation folds of the original training script; the actual split is also limited by the number of valid samples and the class distribution.
原项目图模型训练需要 torch_geometric 及匹配 PyTorch/C: Graph model training in the original project requires torch_geometric and graph operators matching PyTorch/CUDA; these dependencies are missing from the current public environment.

dMRI noise level estimation and denoising using Marchenko-Pastur PCA
DWI data denoising and noise map estimation by exploiting data redundancy in the PCA domain using the prior knowledge that the eigenspectrum of random covariance matrices is described by the universal Marchenko-Pastur (MP) distribution. Fitting the MP distribution to the spectrum of patch-wise signal matrices hence provides an estimator of the noise level 'sigma', as was first shown in Veraart et al. (2016) and later improved in Cordero-Grande et al. (2019). This noise level estimate then determines the optimal cut-off for PCA denoising.
Important note: image denoising must be performed as the first step of the image processing pipeline. The routine will fail if interpolation or smoothing has been applied to the data prior to denoising.
Note that this function does not correct for non-Gaussian noise biases present in magnitude-reconstructed MRI images. If available, including the MRI phase data can reduce such non-Gaussian biases, and the command now supports complex input data.

Remove Gibbs Ringing Artifacts
This application attempts to remove Gibbs ringing artefacts from MRI images using the method of local subvoxel-shifts proposed by Kellner et al. (see reference below for details).
This command is designed to run on data directly after it has been reconstructed by the scanner, before any interpolation of any kind has taken place. You should not run this command after any form of motion correction (e.g. not after dwifslpreproc). Similarly, if you intend running dwidenoise, you should run denoising before this command to not alter the noise structure, which would impact on dwidenoise's performance.
For best results, any form of filtering performed by the scanner should be disabled, whether performed in the image domain or k-space. This includes elliptic filtering and other filters that are often applied to reduce Gibbs ringing artifacts. While this method can still safely be applied to such data, some residual ringing artefacts may still be present in the output.
Note that this method is designed to work on images acquired with full k-space coverage. If this method is executed on data acquired with partial Fourier (eg. "half-scan") acceleration, it may not fully remove all ringing artifacts, and you may observe residuals of the original artifact in the partial Fourier direction. Nonetheless, application of the method is still considered safe and worthwhile. Users are however encouraged to acquired full-Fourier data where possible.

Create bitwise image by thresholding image intensity
The threshold value to be applied can be determined in one of a number of ways:
- If no relevant command-line option is used, the command will automatically determine an optimal threshold;
- The -abs option provides the threshold value explicitly;
- The -percentile, -top and -bottom options enable more fine-grained control over how the threshold value is determined.
The -mask option only influences those image values that contribute toward the determination of the threshold value; once the threshold is determined, it is applied to the entire image, irrespective of use of the -mask option. If you wish for the voxels outside of the specified mask to additionally be excluded from the output mask, this can be achieved by providing the -out_masked option.
The four operators available through the "-comparison" option ("lt", "le", "ge" and "gt") correspond to "less-than" (<), "less-than-or-equal" (<=), "greater-than-or-equal" (>=) and "greater-than" (>). This offers fine-grained control over how the thresholding operation will behave in the presence of values equivalent to the threshold. By default, the command will select voxels with values greater than or equal to the determined threshold ("ge"); unless the -bottom option is used, in which case after a threshold is determined from the relevant lowest-valued image voxels, those voxels with values less than or equal to that threshold ("le") are selected. This provides more fine-grained control than the -invert option; the latter is provided for backwards compatibility, but is equivalent to selection of the opposite comparison within this selection.
If no output image path is specified, the command will instead write to standard output the determined threshold value.

Resample each streamline in a track file to a new set of vertices
It is necessary to specify precisely ONE of the command-line options for controlling how this resampling takes place; this may be either increasing or decreasing the number of samples along each streamline, or may involve changing the positions of the samples according to some specified trajectory.
Note that because the length of a streamline is calculated based on the sums of distances between adjacent vertices, resampling a streamline to a new set of vertices will typically change the quantified length of that streamline; the magnitude of the difference will typically depend on the discrepancy in the number of vertices, with less vertices leading to a shorter length (due to taking chordal lengths of curved trajectories).

调用 FreeSurfer recon-all 完成 T1w 皮层表面重建、皮层: Run FreeSurfer recon-all for T1w cortical surface reconstruction, subcortical segmentation and anatomical atlas parcellation. all runs the full reconstruction; autorecon1/2/3 are consecutive stages, and stats recomputes statistics in an existing subject directory. all/autorecon3 expose mri/aparc+aseg.mgz as a Desikan-Killiany cortical plus subcortical node image, not just a result folder. Labels are in the subject structural space, not automatically aligned to DWI or streamlines. Connectome use requires checking alignment and the atlas lookup table; labelconvert remaps IDs but does not register images. Tissue segmentation, 5TT and data-driven clusters are different products.
包含 mri、surf、label、stats 的 FreeSurfer 受试者: FreeSurfer subject directory containing mri, surf, label and stats. Its existence alone does not certify completion of later stages; use the stage-specific file ports for downstream binding.
供 autorecon2、autorecon3 或 stats 续跑使用的已有受: Existing subject directory for autorecon2, autorecon3 or stats, with the prerequisite stages completed. Resume within the same SUBJECTS_DIR; this is not a raw T1w file.
FreeSurfer 受试者标准化体素网格中的 T1 体数据，可能不同于原始采集: Conformed T1 volume in the FreeSurfer subject grid. This grid may differ from the original acquisition and from DWI.
去除颅骨后的 T1 强度图像。虽然文件名为 brainmask.mgz，但它不是: Skull-stripped T1 intensities, despite the filename brainmask.mgz. This is not a binary brain mask.
受试者结构像空间中的 Desikan-Killiany 皮层及 aseg 皮层下: Integer Desikan-Killiany cortical and aseg subcortical labels in subject structural space. FreeSurferColorLUT defines label meaning; labels are not contiguous connectome indices. Confirm alignment to streamlines, and remap with the appropriate LUT if needed. Do not use linear interpolation for labels.
受试者空间中的 FreeSurfer 解剖分割标签。此文件本身不包含 aparc: FreeSurfer anatomical segmentation labels in subject space. This alone does not provide the cortical atlas regions contained in aparc+aseg.mgz.
包含标签编号、体素数和体积的脑区统计表。这是文本报告，不能作为空间节点图像。: Region statistics table with label IDs, voxel counts and volumes. It is a text report, not a spatial node image.
使用源和目标查找表重新映射连接矩阵节点的整数标签。FreeSurfer 解剖图谱: Remap integer connectome node labels using source and target lookup tables. For a FreeSurfer anatomical atlas, use aparc+aseg.mgz with its matching FreeSurferColorLUT and the intended MRtrix atlas LUT. The output can use contiguous node indices for tck2connectome. This command does not produce anatomical segmentation, estimate registration or change the input coordinate space.
已有整数节点分区图像，其标签编号必须与 lut_in 匹配。可使用 MGZ、NI: Existing integer node parcellation whose label IDs match lut_in. The image may be MGZ, NIfTI or MIF; confirm the intended anatomical atlas and coordinate space.
节点编号及顺序由 lut_out 定义的分区图像，空间坐标不变。编号转换不能证明: Node image with IDs/order defined by lut_out; spatial coordinates are unchanged. Remapping does not demonstrate alignment to streamlines.
与纤维轨迹处于同一物理坐标空间的整数节点分区。必须核实受试者、图谱、空间对齐和标: Integer-valued node parcellation in the same physical coordinate space as the tractogram. Verify subject, atlas, alignment and label-to-node mapping. Native anatomical labels may need LUT remapping and registration with nearest-neighbour resampling; tissue classes, 5TT and statistical maps are not substitutes.
FAST 生成的整数组织类别分割（例如脑脊液、灰质和白质，具体取决于影像类型与类: Integer tissue-class segmentation produced by FAST (for example CSF, grey and white matter depending on image type and class count). These are tissue classes, not cortical/subcortical atlas parcels or connectome node IDs.
使用已有 bedpostx 样本进行概率追踪得到的体素访问/路径分布，其数值尺度: Voxel visitation/path distribution from probabilistic tracking using existing bedpostx samples. Its scale depends on sampling and normalization settings. It is not a streamline file or an ROI-to-ROI matrix.
使用已有 kmeans 参考实现，对一组已对齐图像及共同掩膜进行数据驱动空间聚类: Create data-driven spatial clusters using the existing kmeans reference implementation on a list of aligned images and a common mask. The requested cluster count controls a learned label map. Cluster IDs have no predefined anatomical atlas meaning and are not a drop-in substitute for a FreeSurfer anatomical parcellation. Use only when this data-driven region definition matches the study; validate alignment, reproducibility and region interpretation before connectivity analysis.

Brain-PAD 是校正后的预测年龄与实际年龄之差，其解释依赖训练参考人群和偏: Brain-PAD is corrected predicted age minus chronological age. Interpretation depends on the training reference population and bias correction; it is not a disease diagnosis or causal effect by itself.
ICA 入口会处理检测到的 EOG/ECG 关联成分和明确指定的排除成分；其他伪: The ICA entry handles detected EOG/ECG-related components and explicitly excluded components; this does not establish that other artifacts have been removed.
PPMI 中的 DaTscan 是 SPECT 数据，不能直接套用 PET SU: DaTscan in PPMI is SPECT data; PET SUVR tracer and reference-region definitions must not be directly applied.
QSIPrep 输入需要可对应的 DWI、bval、bvec 和 sidecar: QSIPrep needs matching DWI, bval, bvec and sidecar files; one NIfTI image alone does not establish the BIDS inputs required for diffusion preprocessing.
SUVR 归一化不等于部分容积校正或动态 PET 动力学建模。: SUVR normalization is not partial-volume correction or dynamic PET kinetic modeling.
UKB 导出字段映射、疾病来源和随访日期随研究而变，不能由影像文件名推断这些分析: UKB export mappings, disease sources and follow-up dates vary by study and cannot be inferred from image filenames.
aparc+aseg 的脑区标签与 5TT 的组织分类用途不同；FreeSurf: Brain-region labels in aparc+aseg and tissue classes in 5TT serve different purposes. FreeSurfer outputs are in subject anatomical space and cannot be assumed to be node parcellations in DWI space.
k-means 或层次聚类产生的数据驱动分区不等于解剖图谱；当前图像平滑和滤波入: Data-driven parcellations from k-means or hierarchical clustering are not anatomical atlases; the current image smoothing and filtering entry does not estimate registration or motion correction.
max_files 和 sample_subjects 会限制巡检范围；有限采样: max_files and sample_subjects bound inspection scope; failing to find a file in limited samples does not prove the modality is absent from the entire dataset.
二级分析需要对齐的受试者效应图与匹配的设计矩阵；分类预测分数不能直接当成 GLM: Second-level analysis requires aligned subject effect maps and a matching design matrix; classification prediction scores are not GLM contrast effect maps.
先区分 ID1000、PIOP1 与 PIOP2 的任务和表型定义；已有 BID: Distinguish task and phenotype definitions in ID1000, PIOP1 and PIOP2; restage existing BIDS data only when explicit file mappings are needed.
先区分结构像脑提取、组织分割、脑区分区和表面重建；连接组所需的脑区标签不能由组织: Distinguish anatomical brain extraction, tissue segmentation, regional parcellation and surface reconstruction; tissue masks cannot substitute for brain-region labels required by connectomes.
先区分连续 EEG 清理、事件分段、时频分析和特征建模；需要事件锁定结果时确认事: Distinguish continuous EEG cleaning, event epoching, time-frequency analysis and feature modeling; event-locked results require event codes and epoch windows.
先确定预测、分型、删失结局或处理效应目标，再按表格、连接矩阵、时序或 3D 输入: First establish prediction, subtyping, censored-outcome or treatment-effect goals, then narrow models by tabular, connectivity-matrix, sequence or 3D input form.
先确认处理变量、结局变量和处理效应目标，再选择 CATE 或策略评估；一般表型预: Establish treatment, outcome and the treatment-effect target before choosing CATE or policy evaluation; ordinary phenotype prediction must not automatically become causal inference.
删除重复行前区分录入重复与真实的重复测量；缺失值处理策略按列含义选择，不能对标识: Before deduplication, distinguish duplicate entries from genuine repeated measurements; choose missing-value treatment by column meaning, without mean-imputing identifiers or category codes.
刺激响应分析先核对 NSD 刺激标识与 COCO 元数据的关联，再对齐受试者和: For stimulus-response analysis, verify links between NSD stimulus IDs and COCO metadata before aligning subjects and sessions; image counts do not replace stimulus mappings.
单受试者任务效应选择一级 GLM；跨受试者推断选择二级 GLM，并核对一级对比定: Choose first-level GLM for single-subject task effects and second-level GLM for across-subject inference, checking consistency of first-level contrasts.
单次病灶负荷选择病灶统计；纵向变化选择同一受试者跨时点的病灶比较，并明确是否具有: Choose lesion statistics for single-timepoint burden and within-subject cross-timepoint comparison for longitudinal change, explicitly establishing ground-truth availability.
原始 DICOM 中缺失的切片时序不能靠额外转换开关恢复。: Missing slice timing in source DICOM cannot be recovered by adding a conversion flag.
受试者级表格选择经典分类或回归；序列张量交给 temporal-models，完: Choose classical classification or regression for subject-level tables, temporal-models for sequence tensors and cnn3d for full 3D volumes.
含删失的随访结局选择生存模型，并明确随访时长列、事件列和时间单位；不要改成普通回: Use survival models for censored follow-up outcomes, explicitly specifying duration, event columns and time units; do not replace them with ordinary regression labels.
启用 FreeSurfer 表面重建前需要有效许可证；关闭表面重建时不能把表面或: FreeSurfer surface reconstruction requires a valid license. When surface reconstruction is disabled, surface or parcellation outputs must not be assumed to exist.
导出的相对风险分数不等于某个时间点的绝对事件概率；概率解释需要另行指定时间窗与校: An exported relative-risk score is not an absolute event probability at a time point; probability interpretation needs a specified horizon and calibration method.
已有 FreeSurfer subject 目录时先确认 recon-all 已: For an existing FreeSurfer subject directory, establish completed recon-all stages before choosing reconstruction continuation or statistics extraction.
已有文件需重新命名或分配 subject/session 时使用显式文件映射；原: Use explicit file mappings when existing files need renaming or subject/session assignment; use dcm2nii for source DICOM conversion.
已有预处理 BOLD 仅需混杂回归或连接分析时转用 nilearn-tool；需: Use nilearn-tool when existing preprocessed BOLD only needs confound regression or connectivity analysis; choose fMRIPrep to generate preprocessing derivatives from BIDS functional images.
当前 ADNI 专属引用只包含巡检与 DICOM 转换；表型提取或完整 ADNI: Current ADNI-specific references only contain inspection and DICOM conversion; phenotype extraction or complete ADNI analysis requires other matching methods and cannot be inferred from historical notes.
当前区域摘要入口计算的是滤波后时间标准差及 Mask 内标准化结果，不能因源脚本: The current regional-summary entry computes filtered temporal standard deviation and within-mask normalization; the source script name zALFF does not make it frequency-domain ALFF.
当前已登记的影像入口提供巡检、头信息检查与保存已有影像；批量算法预处理不能由这些: Currently registered image entries provide inspection, header checks and saving existing images; these format operations do not replace batch algorithmic preprocessing.
当前登记的是警觉状态分类入口；连续警觉量不能未经明确标签转换就当作离散类别输入。: The currently registered entry classifies vigilance states; continuous vigilance values must not be treated as discrete classes without an explicit label conversion.
当前转换入口只接受单个 3D NIfTI；4D fMRI 或 DWI 不能直接作: The current converter accepts a single 3D NIfTI volume; 4D fMRI or DWI cannot be directly converted as one DICOM series.
情绪分类按受试者划分验证组，并保留 session 与 trial 的标签对应；: For emotion classification, split validation groups by subject and preserve session/trial label correspondence; multiple segments from one subject are not independent subjects.
报告仅汇总已有流程、参数与结果清单，不会因生成报告而补跑计算或产生缺失的结果。: Reports summarize existing workflows, parameters and result inventories; generating a report does not run missing computations or create absent results.
按 ASL 的标记方案与采集时序选择定量参数；绝对 CBF 与相对 CBF 需明: Choose quantification parameters from the ASL labeling scheme and acquisition timing; distinguish absolute from relative CBF.
按实际可用的 MRI 或 MEG 输入选择分支；MEG 的 evoked 分析不: Choose branches from actually available MRI or MEG inputs; complete MRI modalities do not establish inputs for MEG evoked analysis.
按需要处理均值/方差、非线性协变量或协方差差异选择 ComBat、ComBat-: Choose ComBat, ComBat-GAM or CovBat according to mean/variance, nonlinear covariate or covariance differences; age range alone must not determine the choice.
文件名检查和补齐 dataset_description.json 不构成完整: Filename checks and adding dataset_description.json do not constitute full BIDS validation or recover missing acquisition metadata.
未知数据组织先巡检；合并表格时确认键列与一对一/一对多关系，再按实际可用模态选择: Inspect unknown data organization first; for table joins, establish keys and one-to-one or one-to-many relationships before choosing analysis entries from available modalities.
本地 ADNI 数据先区分 DICOM 和已有 NIfTI；前者可选择转换，后者: For local ADNI data, distinguish DICOM from existing NIfTI; choose conversion for the former and directory/image metadata inspection for the latter.
混杂回归、时间滤波、ROI 功能连接和任务 GLM 分别选择对应入口；它们不自动: Select separate entries for confound regression, temporal filtering, ROI connectivity and task GLM; these do not automatically form complete preprocessing of raw BOLD.
画连接组时核对矩阵行列、图谱标签和节点位置的对应；导出彩色表面时核对表面与 an: For connectome plots, verify the correspondence of matrix rows and columns, atlas labels and node locations; for colored surface export, verify vertex correspondence between the surface and annot.
疾病病例提取先确定疾病或 ICD 定义；生存数据构造再明确基线列和截止日期，不能: For disease-case extraction, define the disease or ICD criteria first; survival-data construction additionally needs explicit baseline and censor dates rather than defaults from unrelated studies.
目标为任务对比图时检查事件表和对比定义并选择 GLM；目标为功能连接矩阵时检查分: For task contrast maps, check events and contrast definitions and choose GLM; for functional connectivity matrices, check the parcellation atlas and ROI time-series extraction.
目标是从连接组边预测表型时选择 CPM；先按 subject_id 对齐连接矩阵: Choose CPM to predict phenotypes from connectome edges; align connectomes and labels by subject_id instead of file order.
站点与研究目标高度混杂、测试站点未见或站点样本不足时，需要评估校正是否可识别以及: When site and the study target are strongly confounded, test sites are unseen or site samples are insufficient, assess identifiability and whether adjustment removes the target effect.
缺少 M0 时不能报告绝对 CBF；缺少可信 PLD 或标记时长时不能用默认数值: Without M0, absolute CBF cannot be reported. Missing reliable PLD or labeling duration must not be replaced by defaults for the acquisition protocol.
聚类编号表示模型得到的分组，不自动对应临床诊断类别；分型解释还需独立稳定性和外部: Cluster indices identify model-derived groups, not clinical diagnostic categories; subtype interpretation also needs independent stability and external phenotype checks.
表格特征预测选择 MVPA，逐 ROI 统计推断选择 ROI GLM，空间局部预: Choose MVPA for tabular prediction, ROI GLM for ROI-wise statistical inference and SearchLight for spatial local-prediction maps; their results have different scientific meanings.
计算 SUVR 前先确定示踪剂、参考区定义与分析帧；参考 Mask 和目标 Ma: Before computing SUVR, establish the tracer, reference-region definition and analysis frame; reference and target masks must align with the PET grid.
读取或重新保存影像保留的是数据和几何信息，不执行配准；体素坐标必须结合 affi: Reading or resaving an image handles data and geometry without registration; voxel coordinates require the affine to be interpreted as spatial coordinates.
运动或涡流校正后应核对旋转后的 bvec 与当前 DWI；ROI 统计还要求图谱: After motion or eddy correction, verify rotated bvecs against the current DWI; ROI statistics also require the atlas and metric images to share the voxel space.
需要 ANTs 的配准、偏置场校正、图像运算或标签统计，并明确所需输入的空间与维: Use ANTs for registration, bias-field correction, image operations or label statistics, with explicit spatial and dimensional requirements for the inputs.
需要 FA、MD 等张量指标时选择张量拟合；FOD 估计和基于 FOD 的追踪应: Choose tensor fitting for FA, MD and other tensor metrics; look up the corresponding MRtrix3 entries for FOD estimation and FOD-based tracking.
需要 evoked 结果时可复用已有 Epochs；传感器层分析与源空间分析需分: Reuse existing Epochs when evoked responses are needed; establish inputs separately for sensor-level and source-space analysis.
需要关闭 JSON sidecar 时选择通用 GZip 预设或独立转换方法，避: When JSON sidecars must be disabled, use the general GZip preset or the atomic converter instead of the preset that enforces JSON generation.
